name: Berggasthaus Hermine
beschreibung: Berggasthaus Hermine operates as a youth hostel in the municipality of Zams. The property is located in the Landeck district at the entrance to the Kaunertal valley. It features multi-bed rooms and shared common areas. A lounge with a kitchenette is available to guests for self-catering. The location provides easy access to summer hiking and winter skiing on Mount Venet. Meals can be booked upon request. The hostel is well suited for groups, families, and individual travelers.
